message:
fix(deploy, maint r2, Codex M1): the phase of a failed swap and the state of the published pair, said apart

A failed swap said "manifest-only -> the published pair does not match (clients refuse it)". That is a
phase, not a verdict: re-publishing the SAME signed release with only the signature rename failing leaves
a valid pair (Codex reproduced the false diagnosis). Now, still exit 4 and nothing undone:
- swap-state (which .tmp is left, read-only) is labelled a phase;
- pair-state reads the published pair back (read-only), compares it with this release's bytes and runs
  the same verifier and key as the checks before the swap: verified-this-release / verified-another-pair
  / does-not-verify / incomplete / unknown. "Clients refuse" is said only for does-not-verify.

Deploy test: the fixture is MADE (Codex GO): one small file per name the product replaces today (read
from the payload gate's own source), a manifest with their sizes/hashes/urls, signed by the release
signing script with a throwaway key made for the run; its public half reaches only the deploy child as
GNLINK_PUBLIC_KEY_HEX (the verifier's existing override). The operational key is never read. Case 13:
no pair before / another pair before / the same pair before (M1) / the manifest rename failing / the
read-back failing, each checked against the files actually left and the signature.
Result: 80/80, rc 0 (main was FAILED 31 with the old fixtures). Against b78ea39's script the new test
fails 6 (13c is M1's false "refuse").

CLAUDE.md: the release section says phase and pair-state apart.

Product: deploy script (diagnosis only). Test: deploy test fixture + case 13. Docs: CLAUDE.md.
